'''Nando's Kricketune''' (Japanese: '''ナオシのコロトック''' ''Naoshi's Korotock'') is a {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} owned by [[Nando]]. It appears to be one of Nando's signature Pokémon, along with his {{TP|Nando|Roserade}}.

==History==
[[File:Nando and Kricketune.png|thumb|left|220px|Kricketune and Nando]]
Kricketune debuted in ''[[DP049|Dawn's Early Night!]]''. It was seen with Nando when he planned to challenge [[Fantina]], but due to her absence, he was unable to do so. He later entered Kricketune in the [[Hearthome City]] [[Pokémon Contest]], where it competed in a [[Double Performance]] alongside his {{p|Sunflora}}. By combining their {{m|Sing}} and {{m|Grass Whistle}} moves, they put on a stunning musical performance that impressed the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]] and ensured Nando's progression to the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]]. There, Kricketune was seen battling alongside {{TP|Nando|Roselia}} against [[Jessie|Jessilina]]'s {{TP|Jessie|Seviper}} and {{TP|Jessie|Dustox}}. It managed to win the battle with a powerful {{m|X-Scissor}}.

In ''[[DP106|A Breed Stampede!]]'', Kricketune appeared on [[television]] during [[Marian]]'s news report about Pokémon Contests. It was revealed to have helped Nando win the {{to|Beach Rose}} Contest, which earned Nando his fourth [[Ribbon]].

In ''[[DP175|Opposites Interact!]]'', Kricketune was revealed to have helped Nando win his second match in the Battle Stage of the [[Sinnoh Grand Festival]].
[[File:DP183.png|thumb|250px|left|Krickitune battling Heracross]]
[[File:Nando Lopunny Kricketune.png|thumb|250px|At the Grand Festival with Lopunny]]
In ''[[DP176|Coming Full-Festival Circle!]]'', Nando used Kricketune along with his {{p|Lopunny}} to battle [[Zoey]]'s {{p|Mismagius}} and {{p|Leafeon}} in the semifinals. He had devised an elaborate battle strategy for the pair in which Kricketune mimicked a violinist and Lopunny danced like a ballerina. In harmony with his music-themed battling style, he commanded Kricketune to use {{m|Sing}} while Lopunny posed elegantly by its side. However, Zoey had {{pkmn|training|trained}} her Mismagius specifically to use {{m|Lucky Chant}} to counter Sing, a plan which proved successful as it lowered Nando's score. Eventually, Zoey's powerful [[Contest combination|combinations]] forced Nando to fight more directly, and Kricketune performed a vicious exchange of blows with Leafeon before the time ran out, resulting in Zoey's victory.

In ''[[DP183|League Unleashed!]]'', Kricketune was the final Pokémon used by Nando during his battle against {{Ash}} in the first round of the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]]. It faced off against [[Ash's Heracross]], and similarly to its battle with Leafeon, was evenly matched. During the battle, Kricketune used Sing, but just as Zoey in the [[Grand Festival]], Ash was prepared for Nando's signature technique, having taught Heracross {{m|Sleep Talk}} to allow the {{pkmn|category|Single Horn Pokémon}} to execute his moves and dodge his opponent while {{status|sleep}}ing. After a fierce battle, Kricketune was defeated by Heracross's {{m|Horn Attack}}, resulting in Nando's elimination from the tournament.

Kricketune briefly appeared alongside Nando during the ending credits of ''[[M13|Zoroark: Master of Illusions]]''.

==Personality and characteristics==
Kricketune is a versatile Pokémon, helping Nando in both his [[Gym]] challenges and [[Pokémon Contest]]s. As a result, Kricketune possesses experience from regular {{pkmn|battle}}s and [[Contest Battle]]s. True to its species, Kricketune likes to cross its arms in front of its chest to produce melodies, a trait which fits Nando's personality. Due to this, Kricketune has been described by {{an|Dawn}} as the "perfect Pokémon" for Nando.

It appears to be a Pokémon trusted by Nando and being used by him often. The fact that Nando wished to challenge [[Fantina]] with it and even used it during his battle against Ash in the [[Lily of the Valley Conference]], while fully knowing Ash's confidence in {{cat|Ash's Pokémon|his Pokémon}}, reflects his own confidence in his Kricketune. It appears to be a strong Pokémon, taking direct hits from opponents, but still standing on.
